api.name: CapgoAlarmPlugin
api.docs: Capacitor Alarm Plugin interface for managing native OS alarms.

methods.name: createAlarm

tags.name: param
tags.text: options - Options for creating the alarm

tags.name: returns
tags.text: Promise that resolves with the action result

tags.name: throws
tags.text: Error if alarm creation fails or permissions are not granted

tags.name: example

methods.docs:
Create a native OS alarm using the platform clock app.
On Android this uses the Alarm Clock intent; on iOS this uses AlarmKit if available (iOS 16+).
